title: Melody Bus Run
premise: A cheerful singing bus races through a neon night road, switching between two lanes to collect glowing music notes while avoiding jagged roadblocks.
interaction_model: Single-action lane switching via tap/click or keyboard; the run auto-scrolls continuously and the player toggles between two lanes.
objective: Survive as long as possible and collect as many musical notes as possible before hitting a roadblock.
progression: Arcade endless-run structure with immediate restart, increasing movement speed over time, score growth through note collection, and no level map or long-term unlock system.
theme: Music-infused neon road trip with an anthropomorphic singing bus and arcade stage-show energy.
mood: Playful, bright, rhythmic, energetic, and family-friendly with a mild crash-fail sting.
likely_audience: Casual mobile and browser players, children, and anyone who enjoys simple one-button arcade runners with musical personality.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the core loop is a two-lane endless runner with note collection and hazard avoidance. Medium confidence on branding nuances such as whether the setting should be read as a parade, concert route, or stylized night drive, because most worldbuilding is implied through visuals and audio rather than explicit narrative.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished 2D browser arcade game called Melody Bus Run where a cute neon bus with a face drives through a glowing night road and sings short lyric phrases while the player taps or presses space/up/down to switch between exactly two lanes. The run should begin from a flashy start screen, then auto-scroll continuously as the bus stays near the left side of the screen and obstacles approach from the right. Spawn two kinds of lane objects: glowing collectible music notes that increase score by 1 and jagged roadblock rocks that instantly end the run. Make the challenge escalate by gradually increasing movement speed over time, but keep the control scheme to one simple lane-toggle input for mobile-friendly play. Present the world with a full-screen canvas, neon sky gradients, clouds, trees, a stylized road, glowing HUD panels, and a score display. Give the bus expressive animation such as bounce and a singing mouth, and show speech-bubble lyrics when vocal callouts occur. Add strong music-game personality through looping background music, synthesized melody notes, speech-synthesis singing, lane-switch, collect, crash, and game-over sound effects. Reward note pickups with sparkles and celebratory visual feedback, punish crashes with explosive particles and a game-over overlay showing the final score plus a replay button. Keep the overall tone colorful, upbeat, arcade-like, and instantly replayable.
